scope: Production Netlify site in Chrome, real editor and WebAssembly Worker. No physical Uno attached.

checks.name: Legacy localStorage sketch migrates to IndexedDB with custom source intact
Plus menu creates second tab without replacing first sketch
Rename, duplicate, close/reopen and delete confirmation Cancel
Compile B while viewing A keeps source and results separate
Both sketches, open tabs and active tab survive refresh
Both restored sketches and Servo compile using real WASM in production
Local digitalWrite autocomplete remains available after tab switching
Alt+N and Alt+W work; Ctrl+S saves
Command+Z accesses preserved history after switching tabs
Compact light-theme tabs retain editor space; no page overflow visible at 1363x936

limitations: Browser download-event capture timed out after Export All. UI reported export; ZIP bytes, filenames and CRCs were independently verified through actual application handlers and Python in the automated tests.
Chrome normally reserves Ctrl/Command+N and W for browser windows/tabs; Alt alternatives were tested.
No physical USB upload tested in this revision. The unchanged STK500v1 uploader and full readback were exercised with a software port using each tab’s actual WASM-generated HEX.
